--add-default.help: Add a default rule to use the malware name as identifier.

--config.help: Path to the intelmq directory containingetc/*.conf

--count.help: Only show the total number of messages in queues. Only valid for listing queues.

--dryrun.help: Never really pop the message from the input pipeline nor send to output pipeline.

--dsn.help: A complete libpg conninfo string. If not given, it will be loaded from /etc/intelmq/eventdb-serve.conf

--filename.help: Path to mapping file name. Will be downloaded if not given.

--gpg-key.help: fingerprint of gpg key to be used

--group.help: Get status of a group of bots

--harmonization.help: Path to harmonization.conf to be used.

--ignore-older-than-days.help: 1..n skip all events with time.observation older than 1..n day; 0 disabled (allow all)

--index-template.help: save the mapping as a template for newly-created indices

--jsonb.help: Use JSONB type to represent dictionary fields

--malware-family-column.help: Apply the mapping to this column, default: 'classification.identifier'

--malware-name-column.help: Use this column as malware name, default: 'malware.name'

--match-family.help: Add a rules that also match the family name themselves.

--msg.help: Trick the bot to process this JSON instead of the Message in its pipeline.

--mwnmp-ignore-adware.help: Ignore adware in the malware name mapping data. for rules. Ignores all lines with an explicit 'adware' field.

--no-backup.help: Do not create backups of state and configuration files.

--no-connections.help: Do not test the connections to services like redis.

--no-events.help: Skip generating the events table schema

--no-jsonb.help: Do not use JSONB but JSON type to represent dictionary fields

--non-zero.help: Only list non-empty queues or the IDs of enabled bots.

--objects.help: Path to misp-objects repository. The generated template will be written to this path or updated in this path.

--partition-key.help: Add given field to the primary key of the events table to allow partitioning in the database. Useful especially for setups with TimescaleDB, see IntelMQ documentation for more advices. If combined with --separate-raws, the v_events does not get foreign key

--password.help: PostgreSQL password, will be queried on stdin.

--previous.help: Use this version as the previous one.

--separate-raws.help: Generate v_events view to separate raw field from the rest of the data on insert

--show-sent.help: If message is sent through, displays it.

--skip-or-replace.help: Add IF NOT EXISTS or REPLACE directive to created schemas

--skip-webserver.help: Skip all operations on the webserver configuration, affects the API and Manager.

--state-file.help: The state file location to use.

--truncate.help: Truncate raw-data with more characters than given. 0 for no truncating. Default: 1000.

--type.help: choose if it should return regular text or other machine-readable

--url.help: The URL to download the mapping from.

--webserver-configuration-directory.help: The webserver configuration directory to use instead of auto-detection.

--webserver-user.help: The webserver to use instead of auto-detection.

console_type.help: You may specify which console should be run. Default is ipdb (if installed) or pudb (if installed) or pdb but you may want to use another one.

filename.help: The filename to write the converted mapping to. If not given, printed to stdout.

log.help: Get last log lines of a bot

message.help: Debug bot's pipelines. Get the message in the input pipeline, pop it (cut it) and display it, or send the message directly to bot's output pipeline(s).

message_action_kind.help: get: show the next message in the source pipeline. pop: show and delete the next message in the source pipeline send: Send the given message to the destination pipeline(s).

msg.help: If send was chosen, put here the message in JSON.

process.help: Single run of bot's process() method.

status.help: Status of a bot or botnet

upgrade-config.help: Upgrade IntelMQ configuration to a newer version.
